name: Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited
summary: Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited engages in the provision of eye care and related services in India, Ghana, Uganda, Kenya, Madagascar, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, Mozambique, and Mauritius.
